The '''Drashtine Initiative''' was an act introduced to the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]] that sought to punish the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] for the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction of Caamas]].
